label: ELEX sandboxes
description: How ELEX sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Mod folders go in data/packed. The executable is in the system folder.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
